command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set +e

run_gate() {
  local n="$1"; shift
  local cmd="$*"
  echo ""
  echo "============================================================"
  echo "GATE: $n"
  echo "CMD : $cmd"
  echo "============================================================"
  local start=$(date +%s)
  eval "$cmd" > /tmp/gate.log 2>&1
  local rc=$?
  local end=$(date +%s)
  echo "--- last 12 lines of output ---"
  tail -12 /tmp/gate.log
  echo "--- gate $n: rc=$rc duration=$((end-start))s ---"
  printf '%-45s  %s  (%ds)\n' "$n" "$([ $rc -eq 0 ] && echo PASS || echo FAIL:$rc)" "$((end-start))" >> /tmp/summary.txt
  return $rc
}

: > /tmp/summary.txt

echo '######## VALIDATION SUITE START ' $(date) ' ########'

run_gate 'pnpm typecheck'                  pnpm typecheck
run_gate 'pnpm web test'                   'CI=true pnpm --filter @vac-web/web test'
run_gate 'pnpm web lint'                   'pnpm --filter @vac-web/web lint'
run_gate 'cargo test local-bridge --lib'   'cargo test -p local-bridge --lib --quiet'
run_gate 'cargo test mock-engine'          'cargo test -p mock-engine --quiet'
run_gate 'cargo test perf'                 'cargo test -p perf --quiet'
run_gate 'verify-codegen'                  'bash scripts/verify-codegen.sh'
run_gate 'check-architecture-boundaries'   'node scripts/check-architecture-boundaries.mjs'
run_gate 'check-capability-coverage'       'node scripts/check-capability-coverage.mjs'
run_gate 'check-slo-budgets (structural)'  'node scripts/check-slo-budgets.mjs'
run_gate 'check-slo-measurements (smoke)'  'cargo run -p perf --quiet -- --duration 1 --output /tmp/perf-smoke.json && node scripts/check-slo-measurements.mjs /tmp/perf-smoke.json --strict'
run_gate 'cargo fmt --check'               'cargo fmt --all -- --check'

echo ''
echo '######## VALIDATION SUITE SUMMARY ########'
cat /tmp/summary.txt
echo '##########################################'
rm -f /tmp/perf-smoke.json /tmp/gate.log
